retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a centered black-and-white portrait framed by a wide white border with bold red serif headers.
triggerTerms: framed monochrome portrait with red text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered rectangular black-and-white photograph of a male artist in a garden setting, surrounded by a thick off-white border. The layout uses high-contrast red serif typography for the artist name and secondary information, with a thin horizontal rule separating the header elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome central image vs. vibrant red typography
Wide negative space border framing the subject
Horizontal rule connecting primary and secondary header text
Bottom-right corner alignment for secondary branding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered rectangular photograph occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the bold red name at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-left name to top-right subtitle, down to central portrait, ending at bottom-right logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white margins create a clean, archival feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation red against neutral monochrome and low-value background.
paletteRestrictions: No secondary colors beyond red, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Large x-height for the primary name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal rule extending from the baseline of the primary name

composition.position: Top right, aligned with display baseline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold upright serif for the name paired with a lighter, spaced-out italic serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal red line separating header from image area

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, high-contrast serif look of the 70s.
Appropriate for the secondary all-caps subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an off-white square canvas with a centered rectangular black-and-white photograph of a man in 70s attire standing in front of lush foliage. Leave a wide margin at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold red serif text in the top left. Add a thin red horizontal line starting from the text. Place small all-caps italic red text in the top right. Place two lines of red serif text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the central photo strictly black and white?
Is the text color a consistent vibrant red?
Is there a clear horizontal rule in the header?
Is the background a warm off-white rather than pure white?

Weight of the red horizontal rule

Ensure the red text does not bleed into the photograph
postGenerationChecks: Check for correct serif bracket anatomy
Verify the red rule is perfectly horizontal
